limits: An earlier run of the final CI session passed window checks but xwsh did not map or reach its native handoff. The failed run is bound in diagnostic history; startup repeatability remains unresolved.
SG_manageSession and SG_autoSave explicitly disabled; session saving/restoration remains unsupported.
SGI-AccessControl and the unexpected Trusted Path Manager panel require further feature-query investigation.
Window focus, key delivery and titlebar dragging are covered; menus, minimize/maximize, resize, desks and logout remain separate checks.
The winterm command uses the established native shell handoff; foreign signal handlers, terminal resize, gettxt and normal application exit remain open.
This uses native Xvfb in an emulated R4400 Indy; no physical hardware or complete desktop certification.
